name: Simmias Grammaticus
dates: end of the 4th century BC (Paton’s date)
bio: Simmias Grammaticus is one of the epigrammatists whose short poems were gathered in the Greek Anthology. Paton's index of authors dates the poet to end of the 4th century BC. Paton's index lists the poet among the writers of Meleager's Wreath, the Garland compiled about 100 BC.
This archive carries the 1 epigram ascribed to the poet in the first volume of W. R. Paton's prose translation (Books I–VI) (Book VI: 113).

poems.title: Book VI, 113
poems.author: Simmias Grammaticus
poems.text: I was formerly one of the two horns of a wild long-haired ibex, and was garlanded with green leaves ; but now the worker in horn has adapted me for Nicomachus, stretching on me the strong sinew
